name: Lynn Ngugi
title: Founder & CEO
shortBio: Lynn Ngugi is the founder and CEO of Crest Advocates, a law firm serving individuals, families and businesses in Kenya.
bio: Lynn Ngugi founded Crest Advocates with a clear idea of what clients should be able to expect from their lawyers: advice they can understand, and representation they can rely on.
As the firm's CEO, Lynn leads its approach to client service. That means listening first, understanding what is at stake for each client, and explaining options in plain English.
Alongside one-off matters, the firm offers legal retainers that let businesses work with it as an ongoing legal partner rather than only calling when something goes wrong.
